point.primordial_charge_yield: YQ=YB inferred from D+3nu BBN, not fitted to Planck dark density; an additional initial-state postulate.
point.entropy: No later SM entropy injection; hidden U1 exact in adopted EFT.
point.observable: Lower bound on present hidden matter omega=Omega h^2, compared with Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing base-LambdaCDM omega_c.
point.blindness: Published target already known; held out from parameter calibration, not an unseen/blind or prospective prediction.

survival_statement: Q(a) a^3 conserved for exact adopted hidden U(1), no later visible entropy injection. E>=mu_star*mX*abs(Q) at leading classical/semiclassical weak-gravity order. Fission, evaporation into charged X, and unknown formation efficiency cannot erase this net-charge energy floor. This is NOT a computed individual quantum soliton lifetime.
cosmology_assumptions: Primordial rotating condensate is an explicitly imposed initial state; no generation of net hidden charge from zero is derived.
YQ is fixed equal to the observed late baryon yield; equality is an added hypothesis, not forced by the action. SM baryogenesis and sphaleron history are not solved.
No hidden charge breaking, late dilution, gravitational collapse hiding global charge, or compensating negative-energy sector.
Leading scalar potential and weak gravitational binding; all-orders quantum/UV completion not established.

For comparison with omega_c, surviving charge carriers form a cold, effectively collisionless late matter component. A full Boltzmann/structure evolution and CMB angular-spectrum likelihood have not been supplied.
claim_class: Conditional conservative abundance constraint for one fully specified initial-yield point; not an unconditional prediction of GRUT or an experimentally verified composite population.
